label: Company Overview
value_text:
Trescon is a pioneering force in the global business events and services sector connecting businesses with global opportunities. We have been driving the adoption of emerging technologies, while promoting inclusive business leadership since 2016. 

Trescon enables clients to access new opportunities, build lasting partnerships, and stay ahead of emerging trends.

label: Mission
value_text: As we look to the future, Trescon remains committed to pushing boundaries, embracing new technologies, and creating exceptional experiences that shape the business landscape.

label: Vision
value_text: To continue pioneering the future of business events through innovation, sustainability, and meaningful connections that drive global economic growth.

label: Boilerplate: long
value_text:
Trescon connects businesses with opportunities through high-impact business events. Founded in 2016, it brings together enterprises, governments, investors and innovators to learn, collaborate and lead in fast-evolving markets.

Its work spans three event types:
- Signature Events: Trescon's own summits, conferences and expos across artificial intelligence, Web3, cyber security, cloud, financial services and sustainability.
- Managed Events: end-to-end management for governments, enterprises and institutions, from content and speakers to marketing, partnerships and on-site operations.
- Bespoke Events: custom-built events, roundtables and roadshows designed around a client's sales and marketing goals.

Trescon has delivered more than 500 events, each planned around clear objectives and measurable outcomes, including events of more than 10,000 attendees. Its events have hosted more than 500,000 C-level attendees and connected more than 3,500 investors and more than 3,000 speakers with their audiences, with participants from more than 120 countries. Its network includes more than 50 government and policy partners and more than 500 association and media partners.

Based in Dubai, with offices in Bengaluru, Mangalore, Manipal, Doha and Mauritius, Trescon has a team of more than 250 people. Learn more at tresconglobal.com.
